title: CI and the pre-push hook refuse a code-lane commit pushed straight to main
goal: kbgit.py check-lanes [A..B] exits 1 listing each first-parent commit of main that is not a merge and touches the code lane (commits before the check's first commit exempt, as with trailers); the pre-push hook runs it for a push to main, and a kb-lane job runs it on pushes to main in .gitlab-ci.yml and .github/workflows/kb.yml; tests.py -k check_lanes plants a direct code commit and a merged one
